description: The full machine-readable availability feed: free room counts per night by room type, ~180 nights ahead, plus the semantics needed to read it. Use for overviews ('when is there space in October?'); for a specific stay use check_room_availability. Aggregate counts only, no personal data. Read `generated_at` for the real age.
name: get_availability_calendar

outputSchema.description: The availability feed as the booking engine builds it: free room counts per night by room type, with the semantics needed to read it. `generated_at` says how old it is.

title: Get the raw availability calendar
